sources.use: A4 장부의 천 책등·보강 모서리·종이 단면

outputs.prompt: Create a photorealistic modeling reference contact sheet for ordinary stationery in a Korean villa caretaker's office in 2025. Reference image 1 is a real Korean A4 accounting ledger: use its dark forest-green textured cover, cream cloth spine, reinforced cream corners, and layered ivory page edges. Reference image 2 is a real hexagonal graphite pencil: use the physically joined sharpened wood and graphite tip and hexagonal lacquered barrel, but omit all brand names and lettering. Show three consistent objects across views: (a) a closed 22x30cm ledger, 2.8cm thick with cream spine on the reader's left, a small blank cream rectangular paper label on the green front; (b) a separate thin A4 tear-off telephone complaint receipt pad, ivory sheets on a grey card backing, 6mm thick, with the top original sheet torn off leaving an irregular narrow glued stub, a few empty muted blue ruled lines and two old staple holes at the top; (c) one used 15cm yellow and black pencil resting lengthwise on the right margin of the pad. Neutral desk photographs, soft broad daylight, quiet everyday wear only, accurate paper thickness, no exaggerated grime or horror decor. Layout: straight overhead group view, low front angle, side showing actual binding and thin layers, macro of torn paper stub, macro of pencil tip. SAME stationery in each view, no text, no logos, no captions, no watermarks. This sheet is for dimensional modeling, not a game screenshot.

Produce a production texture for a paper-impression rubbing puzzle. A single sheet of warm ivory uncoated office paper fills the entire portrait image edge to edge, flat orthographic scan with perfectly even diffuse light, no visible page edges, no shadows or perspective. THREE distinct broad horizontal swatches made by shading gently with the SIDE of a soft graphite pencil, fine overlapping diagonal strokes, slight uneven pressure and feathered edges. First swatch spans x=12%-88%, y=24%-40%. Second swatch spans x=12%-88%, y=47%-63%. Third swatch spans x=12%-88%, y=70%-86%. Leave the top 20% of the page and all spaces between swatches clean ivory. The swatches are dark enough for pale indented writing to later be composed inside them, but they are naturally scribbled gray, not solid black rectangles. Keep the paper quite clean: subtle fiber and tiny handling marks only. Absolutely NO writing, NO letters, NO words, NO numbers, NO lines of ruled paper, NO symbols, NO pencil or other objects, NO border, NO labels, NO watermark. This is an albedo game texture, not an illustration.

note: 판매처·제조사 원본 사진은 참고용으로만 사용했다. 게임에는 제작한 메시와 생성 질감을 넣었다.
